svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Container architecture
svg.desc: The image build produces a root-owned toolchain and hook configuration; the running container gives the dev user a writable home and a workspace mount, with every agent hook and git hook ultimately calling the osf binary.

g.text: IMAGE BUILD · DOCKERFILE STAGES, RUN AS ROOT
CONTAINER RUNTIME · DEV USER, /WORKSPACE BIND MO…
CODING AGENTS · BUILDER AND REVIEWER ROLES
OSF TOOLING · RUST BINARY AND GIT INTEGRATION
